summary.en: An iterative process: a closed loop of 3–4 steps with a token running one lap per milestone, a timing diagram that steps up once per lap, a read-out, a gate rule and an aside.
summary.zh: 一个循环的流程：3–4 个步骤围成闭环，一个令牌每个里程碑跑一圈，旁边的时序图每圈升一级，读数随之变化，再加一条门限规则和一段旁注。

fits: A process that repeats until it reaches a goal: staged rollouts, retries, training epochs, polling.
notFor: Linear pipelines (use exploded-chain); more than four steps or milestones.

intent.en: Show iteration as laps the eye can count: each lap raises the trace one step, so progress is visible without numbers.
intent.zh: 把迭代画成数得清的圈：每跑一圈时序图升一级，不靠数字也看得出进展。

content.en: Label, title, sub, 3–4 steps (≤ 34), 2–4 milestones (≤ 4), counter and track labels, a gate (title, sub), an aside.
content.zh: 标签、标题、副标题、3–4 个步骤（≤ 8 字）、2–4 个里程碑（≤ 4 字）、计数和轨道标签、门限（标题、副注）、旁注。

fits.zh: 重复到达成目标为止的流程：分阶段发布、重试、训练轮次、轮询。

notFor.zh: 线性流水线（用 exploded-chain）；超过四个步骤或里程碑。

en: Four two-word steps and a long gate push the reading past the build; keep steps to one word where possible.
zh: 四个双词步骤加一条长门限会让阅读时间超出构建时长；步骤尽量一个词。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
